clips.title: 预算越紧：黑五支出反增5.4%，钱到底花去哪了

subtitles.en: Stretched US consumers headed into Black Friday with strict budgets.
subtitles.zh: 手头紧张的美国消费者带着严格预算迎接黑色星期五。

subtitles.en: Yet, total holiday spending is still expected to climb 5.4% this year.
subtitles.zh: 然而，今年假日总支出预计仍将增长5.4%。

subtitles.en: With Americans projected to spend nearly $13 billion online on Black Friday deals alone.
subtitles.zh: 仅黑色星期五促销，美国人网上消费预计就将接近130亿美元。

subtitles.en: Despite high fuel costs and lingering inflation, shoppers aren't sitting this season out.
subtitles.zh: 尽管燃料成本高企、通胀持续，消费者并未缺席这个购物季。

subtitles.en: They are simply getting more strategic. According to PWC, 40% of consumers are hunting for resale and vintage deals.
subtitles.zh: 他们只是变得更讲究策略。普华永道称，40%的消费者在寻找转售和复古商品优惠。

subtitles.en: While others are trimming their gift list or swapping tack for screen-free gifts.
subtitles.zh: 其他人则在缩减礼物清单，或将实物礼品换成无屏幕礼物。

subtitles.en: Recent widespread tech outages across banks and flight systems also sparked a wave of proper buying for generators and bottled water at Walmart and Costco.
subtitles.zh: 近期银行和航班系统的大范围技术故障，也引发了在沃尔玛和好市多抢购发电机和瓶装水的风潮。

subtitles.en: A cautious mindset trickling into holiday shopping. Coals and Dollar Tree are even drawing in higher-income bargain hunters, with expanded $3 to $20 gift sections.
subtitles.zh: 谨慎心态正蔓延至假日购物。Coals和Dollar Tree甚至吸引了高收入淘便宜货者，扩大了3至20美元的礼品区。

subtitles.en: As Dollar Tree CEO put it, shoppers are cherishing value and buying closer to need.
subtitles.zh: 正如Dollar Tree首席执行官所说，消费者珍视价值，按需购买。

terms.context: US retail holiday shopping day after Thanksgiving

clip_research.source_claim: Despite stretched budgets, total US holiday spending is still expected to climb 5.4% this year, with nearly $13 billion spent online on Black Friday alone.
clip_research.public_baseline: Bloomberg's own quicktake notes contemporary shopping trends have watered down Black Friday's appeal, with sales spread across a longer weekend and earlier in the season.
clip_research.surprise_gap: Consumers tightening budgets yet aggregate holiday spend still rising 5.4% is a mild tension worth flagging, but the public snippet does not confirm the 5.4% figure.

evidence.fact: Total holiday spending expected to climb 5.4%; ~$13B online on Black Friday.
PwC: 40% of consumers hunting resale and vintage deals.

forbidden_claims: Do not assert the 5.4% or $13B figures as independently verified—only as the clip's claim.
Do not claim Bloomberg endorses a bearish consumer view; this is a news report, not an editorial.
Do not identify 'Coals' as Kohl's without confirmation.
Do not claim a China advantage; none is stated.

notes: Only one clip provided; entity list scoped to clip 1.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
